text:
Emily K: Heads up — candidate Taylor (SWE-IC) scheduled for Fri 4/18 16:00 PT. Need panel confirmation + a behavioral backup. Taylor requested an extra 15m for accessibility. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890. Debrief doc: https://drive.company.com/interviews/taylor-debrief (please don't edit final notes until after).

Emily K: Proposed flow (please keep strict timing):
```
16:00-16:05 intro & setup
16:05-16:35 system design (Jorge)
16:35-16:55 take-home walk-through (Priya)
16:55-17:10 behavioral + close (Samir or backup)
```
Add 15m buffer at end for accessibility if candidate needs it — we can shorten intros.

Jorge M: I can cover system design. Can someone drop Taylor's resume in the doc? Also I have another meeting until 4:00 PT so a 4:10 start would be easier.

Priya S: I can do take-home. 4:10 start is fine for me — I'll be free at 4:05. Also noted accessibility request, I'll enable screen-reader mode on my machine.

Samir P: I'm oncall that afternoon, so I won't be able to do behavioral as primary. I can act as a hot backup for last 10m if pager is quiet. Nina — can you find someone for behavioral who can be primary? @Ben or @Aisha?

Nina (People Ops): I can step in as backup behavioral interviewer but prefer not primary. I'll ping Aisha and Ben now and post confirmation here in 10m.

Priya S: Small admin note — candidate asked for screen-reader friendly copy of the take-home artifacts. Please upload files to the shared folder: /interviews/taylor/assets so I can pull them.

CalendarBot: Event created: Taylor — SWE-IC (virtual) Fri Apr 18 16:00 PT. Attendees: Emily K, Jorge M, Priya S, Nina (People Ops). Location: Zoom.

Emily K: Thanks all. Two quick reminders: 1) please use the debrief rubric in the doc and leave scores + 3-line notes within 24h; 2) scoring anchors = 1 major gap, 3 meets bar, 5 outstanding. I'll put a short anchor table at the top of the debrief doc. :memo:

Jorge M: :thumbsup: Dropping resume into the doc now. Emily — quick timezone check: 16:00 PT -> 00:00 BST for candidate, right?

Emily K: Taylor is in London (BST). 16:00 PT -> 00:00 BST; candidate said they can do up to 00:30 BST, so we need to keep things tight.

Samir P: Understood. If I get paged I may need to drop — I'll DM Ben to see if he can swap in case. If anyone else suddenly can't make it, please escalate to People Ops.

Nina (People Ops): Update: Aisha can do behavioral primary. Marking event attendee and adding Aisha to invite.

Emily K: Awesome, thanks Nina + Aisha. Final ask: everyone preview the debrief doc before the interview, and when in doubt mark "needs follow-up" rather than leaving gaps. Appreciate the quick responses. :pray:
